overview: CEFR Master is an English course platform for B1, B2 and C1 students with mock tests, reading, listening, speaking, writing, a dictionary, a link library and a no-code admin dashboard.
features: Mock Tests Hub with full-length and topic-wise tests, level and skill filters, a timed test runner with question navigator and flagging, and a result summary with a CEFR level estimate
Reading practice with passages beside their questions, adjustable font size, text highlighting and a start/pause/reset timer
Listening practice with a custom audio player, speed control, skip controls and play-once mode
Speaking practice with question cards by level, prep and speaking countdowns, and voice recording with playback and download
Writing practice with essay prompts, a live word counter, autosaved drafts and a collapsible model answer
Dictionary with CEFR level badges, definitions, synonyms, example sentences, pronunciation audio, saved words and flashcards
Link library of external resources with search and category filters
Admin dashboard with passcode login to create, edit and delete all content, plus JSON import and export
Dark and light theme with a cursor flashlight effect and glowing cards
